card.summary: No published total storage cap. 15 GB per file standard, 30 GB for Premium/monetised channels; up to 8 hours duration.

free_tier.stated: No published total storage cap. 15 GB per file standard, 30 GB for Premium/monetised channels; up to 8 hours duration.

egress.terms: Free. Rumble serves its own CDN, no egress billing.

record.tooling: yt-dlp `Rumble`, `RumbleChannel`, `RumbleEmbed` extractors (verified present). No public upload API; upload is web-only.
record.chaining: Unlimited files x unlimited accounts at 15 GB each. No documented daily cap, which is unusual and useful.
record.limits_note: 15 GB/file is mid-tier. Upload is web-form only. This is the automation blocker, since yt-dlp solves retrieval but nothing solves programmatic upload.
record.reliability_note: Direct FAQ documentation was unreachable during testing on 2026-10-21. The 15 GB maximum video upload figure is reported in third-party platform documentation.
